t: Excellent but not for permanent records
x: I homeschool my children and need to maintain records of what my children did for school each day as well as their grades and other important documents.  To differentiate my pens from that of my children I exclusively use green ink.  Perhaps I was misled by the claims of no bleed technology or I misread the information, however, I do believe if there is any amount of moisture on your skin the ink will bleed. I have attached a photo to show bleeding after I came back and wrote on a piece of paper washing my hands and drying g with a paper towel.  Also, they actually do bleed, or "ghost" through paper.  When I write on my children's work I can see my marks and notations on the other side of the page.  I have attached another photo showing the bleed-through.
